eyebrow.zh: 华为云 · 国际产品简介

subtitle.zh: 面向全球研发团队的 AI 软件交付助手。把意图推进到可合并变更，减少跨工具摩擦。
subtitle.en: AI software delivery for global engineering teams. Move intent to merge-ready change with less toolchain friction.

notes.zh: 开场强调国际买家语境：研发效能、工具链协同、企业可控；不谈未核实的价格与 SLA。
notes.en: Open on overseas buyer context: engineering productivity, toolchain fit, and enterprise control. No unverified price or SLA claims.

subtitle.zh: 价值、方式、对照、买家视角，再到下一步行动。
subtitle.en: Value, method, contrast, buyer lenses, then next steps.

notes.zh: 高管精简切面会隐藏本页；完整版用于发现会开场对齐。
notes.en: Hidden on the executive cut. Use the full deck to align discovery workshops.

label.zh: 意图到可交付变更的闭环
碎片化路径 vs Agent 辅助
工程 / 平台 / 治理怎么讲
发现会或 PoC 范围确认

subtitle.zh: 用可验证的交付结果说话；区域合规与容量以正式材料为准。
subtitle.en: Lead with delivery outcomes you can defend. Region compliance and capacity stay confirm-with-marketing.

notes.zh: 三块对应速度、在岗体验、治理姿态；避免承诺具体加速百分比。
notes.en: Three beats: speed, in-flow experience, governance posture. Do not invent acceleration percentages.

body.zh: 在澄清、实现与评审处提供 AI 协助，更快形成可审查、可合并的变更。
body.en: Assist clarification, implementation, and review so teams reach inspectable, merge-ready change sooner.

body.zh: 围绕编码、评审与文档协同，减少工具切换造成的上下文丢失。
body.en: Assist coding, review, and docs in place. Cut context loss from constant tool switching.

body.zh: 按组织工作流设计；权限、审计与协作约定以正式方案和部署区域为准。
body.en: Designed for organizational workflow. Permissions, auditability, and team norms confirm per proposal and region.

subtitle.zh: 可对外讲解的协作闭环；具体集成以 PoC 范围为准。
subtitle.en: A briefable collaboration loop. Concrete integrations stay PoC-scoped.

notes.zh: 演示时按四步走：理解 → 规划 → 生成精炼 → 评审交接；不要展开内部模型细节。
notes.en: Walk four beats: understand, plan, generate and refine, review and handoff. Skip internal model detail.

body.zh: 把业务目标与约束转成可执行的研发任务描述。
body.en: Turn goals and constraints into actionable engineering tasks.

body.zh: 形成步骤化方案，明确改动面与验收关注点。
body.en: Produce a step-wise plan with change surface and acceptance focus.

body.zh: 辅助实现与迭代，保持人类在环审查。
body.en: Assist implementation and iteration while humans stay in review.

body.zh: 沉淀可审查结果，进入团队既有合并与发布流程。
body.en: Land reviewable outcomes in the team's merge and release process.

result.zh: 结果：一条可讲解的 AI 辅助交付闭环。强化节奏，不替代研发责任。
result.en: Outcome: a briefable AI-assisted delivery loop. Augments engineers; does not replace ownership.

subtitle.zh: 叙事对照，非基准测试；量化收益请在 PoC 中按客户基线测量。
subtitle.en: Narrative contrast, not a benchmark. Measure gains against the customer baseline in a PoC.

notes.zh: 左侧讲碎片化与返工，右侧讲意图驱动与人类在环；不要编造加速百分比。
notes.en: Left = fragmentation and rework. Right = intent-driven flow with humans in the loop. No invented acceleration %.

body.zh: 意图、实现与评审散落在多处工具与对话里，上下文反复丢失。
body.en: Intent, implementation, and review scatter across tools and threads. Context resets constantly.

bullets.zh: 需求澄清与编码脱节，返工成本高
bullets.en: Clarification and coding drift apart; rework stays expensive

bullets.zh: 评审材料不完整，合并前反复补洞
bullets.en: Incomplete review artifacts force last-mile patching before merge

bullets.zh: 治理靠人工追问，难形成可审计闭环
bullets.en: Governance runs on ad-hoc chase-downs instead of an auditable loop

body.zh: 从意图到可审查变更保持同一条讲解路径，人类仍掌握合并决策。
body.en: One briefable path from intent to inspectable change. Humans keep the merge decision.

bullets.zh: 任务框架更清晰，改动面更早对齐
bullets.en: Clearer task framing; change surface aligned earlier

bullets.zh: 生成与精炼留在研发主路径，减少切换损耗
bullets.en: Generate-and-refine stays in the engineering flow

bullets.zh: 可审查结果进入既有合并与发布流程
bullets.en: Reviewable outcomes land in existing merge and release process

subtitle.zh: 按角色切换讲法；区域合规、集成与商务条款以正式方案为准。
subtitle.en: Switch the story by role. Region compliance, integrations, and commercial terms confirm in the formal proposal.

notes.zh: 用页签切换 Engineering / Platform / Governance；高管精简切面隐藏本页。
notes.en: Tab through Engineering / Platform / Governance. Hidden on the executive cut.

body.zh: 关心交付节奏与质量门禁：更少切换，更快到可合并变更，人工评审仍在。
body.en: Cadence and quality gates matter: less switching, faster path to merge-ready change, humans still review.

bullets.zh: 把业务意图转成可执行任务框架
bullets.en: Turn business intent into actionable task framing

bullets.zh: 实现与评审协助留在研发主路径
bullets.en: Keep implementation and review assist inside the engineering flow

bullets.zh: [占位] IDE / Git 工作流对接范围在 PoC 中确认
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Confirm IDE / Git workflow fit inside PoC scope

body.zh: 关心可嵌入性与边界：Agent 应增强既有流水线，而不是另起影子流程。
body.en: Embeddability and boundaries matter: reinforce the existing pipeline, do not spawn a shadow process.

bullets.zh: 围绕编码、评审与文档协同设计协助点
bullets.en: Place assist points around coding, review, and docs

bullets.zh: 结果交接回团队既有合并与发布路径
bullets.en: Hand outcomes back into the team's merge and release path

bullets.zh: [占位] 集成清单与环境拓扑以 PoC / 架构评审为准
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Integrations and topology confirmed in PoC / architecture review

body.zh: 关心可控边界与可审计姿态：权限、协作约定与区域合规需在正式材料中落定。
body.en: Controllable boundaries and audit posture matter. Permissions, norms, and regional compliance land in formal materials.

bullets.zh: 按组织工作流设计，强调人类在环决策
bullets.en: Designed for organizational workflow with humans-in-the-loop decisions

bullets.zh: [占位] 部署区域、数据驻留与合规声明：确认产品市场与法务
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Deployment region, residency, and compliance: confirm with product marketing / legal

bullets.zh: [占位] 商务条款、容量与 SLA：不以本页承诺
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Commercial terms, capacity, and SLAs: not committed on this slide

把数字世界带入每个人、每个家庭、

vision.en:
Bring digital to every person, home and organization
for a fully connected, intelligent world.
